description.value: Pho Han Restaurant is a Vietnamese family restaurant established in 2011 in the West Cambie neighbourhood of Richmond, serving traditional dishes including pho, grilled lemongrass chicken and pork, banh mi, and fresh salad rolls. The restaurant is located in a strip-mall unit and offers dine-in, phone takeout, and delivery via UberEats. A touring cyclist stopping in Richmond will find a hearty, affordable hot meal well-suited for refuelling.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully accessible and confirms the restaurant is open at #110-9020 Capstan Way, Richmond. The phone number (604) 284-5589 matches OSM exactly. The OSM postcode V6X 1R4 conflicts with the website address postcode V6X 3V9, so the website's full address is used as primary. No mention of bike parking, washrooms, or water refill anywhere in the website content or OSM tags; takeout is explicitly confirmed by the website ('Call us for Take-Out').
concerns: OSM postcode (V6X 1R4) does not match the postcode on the website's address page (V6X 3V9); OSM also lacks any street address — full address taken from website.

Opening hours are inconsistent across sources: OSM tags differ from the website home page, which itself differs from the /visit subpage. No hours included in this record per policy, but the discrepancy may warrant a manual check.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating Vietnamese restaurant with an active website, confirmed phone number, and online ordering. Useful stop for touring cyclists seeking a hot meal in Richmond.

wow_evidence: Vietnamese family restaurant established in 2011 in a strip-mall unit
